methodology.same_day: diagnostic only: sign(flow_T) versus close_T/close_T-1; flow is not known before that same session outcome
methodology.next_trading_day: no-lookahead: sign(flow_T) versus close_T+1/close_T using the first validated final regular-session row, only when no unaccounted weekday exists between T and T+1
methodology.rolling_features: 3d/5d sums contain observations through T only and are omitted across unaccounted trading-day gaps

aggregate_flow_gate.meaning: Flow may only be a capped supporting input. Zero means do not infer the next regular close from participant buying/selling.
